characters.name: Eric Brooks
characters.summary: A half-vampire, half-human hybrid who hunts vampires. Loyal only to his mentor Whistler and his network of allies, he fights against a vampire conspiracy to awaken the ancient vampire lord Dracula.
source_notes: Played by Wesley Snipes in the Blade trilogy (1998–2004). The character is slated to join the MCU, played by Mahershala Ali, in the upcoming Blade.

characters.name: Abraham Whistler
characters.summary: Blade's gruff mentor who tracked down and trained the Daywalker, building the weaponry that lets Blade fight vampires. He aids Blade in the final stand against Dracula.
source_notes: Played by Kris Kristofferson in Blade (1998) and Blade: Trinity (2004).

characters.name: Karen Jenson
characters.summary: A hematologist who is bitten by a vampire while treating Blade and helps him expose the vampire bloodfarming operation as Deacon Frost plots to summon the Blood God.
source_notes: Played by N'Bushe Wright in Blade (1998), the only heroine of the first film.

characters.name: Abigail Whistler
characters.summary: Abraham Whistler's fiery daughter and the leader of the Nightstalkers, a band of vampire hunters. She helps Blade take down Dracula.
source_notes: Played by Jessica Biel in Blade: Trinity (2004).

characters.name: Hannibal King
characters.summary: A wisecracking vampire private eye who joins the Nightstalkers against Dracula. He is later cured by the blood of a vampire-wolf hybrid.
source_notes: Played by Ryan Reynolds in Blade: Trinity (2004).

characters.name: Deacon Frost
characters.summary: An ambitious, contemptuous vampire who seeks to overthrow the vampire hierarchy and summon the Blood God La Magra. He is killed by Blade.
source_notes: Primary antagonist of Blade (1998).

characters.name: Nomak
characters.summary: A pureblood vampire deformed into a ravenous 'Reaper' by a flawed blood-splicing experiment. He leads the Reapers in a war against both vampire houses and the Daywalker.
source_notes: Primary antagonist of Blade II (2002).

characters.name: Eli Damaskinos
characters.summary: The shadowy Pureblood leader of the Prague vampire council who engineered the Reaper experiment. He attempts to use Blade to end the Reaper threat, then betrays him.
source_notes: Primary antagonist of the first half of Blade II (2002).

characters.name: Dracula
characters.summary: The original vampire sire and patriarch of the entire vampire race, resurrected from a mummified state to lead the vampire nation. Defeated when Blade infects him with a vampire-wolf serum and feeds on his blood.
source_notes: Primary antagonist of Blade: Trinity (2004).

characters.name: Danica Talos
characters.summary: The ruthless acting head of the vampire nation who hunts Blade and the Nightstalkers. She is killed by Abigail Whistler.
source_notes: Primary villain of the first act of Blade: Trinity (2004).

characters.name: Frank Castle
characters.summary: A former FBI agent turned vigilante who wages a one-man war against crime after his family is murdered by the Saint family. He targets Howard Saint with ruthless precision.
source_notes: Played by Thomas Jane in The Punisher (2004), a distinct variant from the Netflix and War Zone versions.

characters.name: Howard Saint
characters.summary: A wealthy Tampa crime lord who orders the murder of Frank Castle's family in retaliation, setting off the Punisher's campaign of vengeance. He is destroyed alongside his entire organization.
source_notes: Primary antagonist of The Punisher (2004).

characters.name: Micro
characters.summary: Howard Saint's ruthless lieutenant who carries out the massacre. He later betrays Saint to save his own life.
source_notes: Played by Wayne Knight in The Punisher (2004).

characters.name: Frank Castle
characters.summary: A brutal vigilante who wages war against New York's organized crime. His battle with the disfigured Jigsaw escalates until he destroys the mob and its corrupt officials.
source_notes: Played by Ray Stevenson in Punisher: War Zone (2008), a distinct variant from the 2004 film.

characters.name: Billy Russo
characters.summary: A vicious mobster disfigured by shattered glass in a fight with the Punisher, becoming the monster known as Jigsaw. He wages a brutal campaign of retaliation before being killed.
source_notes: Played by Dominic West in Punisher: War Zone (2008), a distinct variant from the Netflix Billy Russo.

characters.name: Microchip
characters.summary: A criminal weapons-software expert blackmailed into working for Jigsaw. He is ultimately killed in the final confrontation.
source_notes: Played by Ewan Bremner in Punisher: War Zone (2008).

characters.name: Johnny Blaze
characters.summary: A motorcycle stuntman who sells his soul to Mephistopheles to save his father, becoming the fiery Ghost Rider. He rides a flaming motorcycle and hunts the damned, later returning to defeat the Devil's son in Spirit of Vengeance.
source_notes: Played by Nicolas Cage in Ghost Rider (2007) and Ghost Rider: Spirit of Vengeance (2011).

characters.name: Carter Slade
characters.summary: The previous Ghost Rider who now serves as a caretaker and mentor to Johnny Blaze, offering guidance on how to wield the Rider's power.
source_notes: Played by Sam Elliott in Ghost Rider (2007).

characters.name: Mephistopheles
characters.summary: The Devil himself, who engineers Johnny Blaze's transformation. He later wipes Johnny's memory before returning in Spirit of Vengeance to reclaim his son.
source_notes: Played by Peter Fonda in Ghost Rider (2007) and Ciarán Hinds in Spirit of Vengeance (2011).

characters.name: Blackheart
characters.summary: The rebellious son of the Devil who attempts to steal a contract with 1,000 souls to overthrow his father. He is dragged screaming into Hell by the Ghost Rider's Penance Stare.
source_notes: Primary antagonist of Ghost Rider (2007).

characters.name: Matt Murdock
characters.summary: A blind attorney who was blinded and superhumanly sensitized by radioactive waste. By day he defends the innocent; by night he hunts criminals as the horned vigilante Daredevil.
source_notes: Played by Ben Affleck in Daredevil (2003), a distinct variant from the Netflix Matt Murdock.

characters.name: Elektra Natchios
characters.summary: A deadly assassin who romances Matt Murdock. Believed killed by Bullseye, she returns in her own spinoff film, fighting for a young girl threatened by the Hand and their super-powered foes.
source_notes: Played by Jennifer Garner in Daredevil (2003) and Elektra (2005).

characters.name: Bullseye
characters.summary: A bald, psychopathic assassin who can turn virtually anything into a lethal projectile. He kills Elektra and is in turn killed by Daredevil.
source_notes: Played by Colin Farrell in Daredevil (2003), a distinct variant from the Netflix Bullseye.

characters.name: Wilson Fisk
characters.summary: A towering, implacable crime boss who had Matt Murdock and his father killed and rules Hell's Kitchen with brute force. He is confronted and nearly killed by Daredevil.
source_notes: Played by Michael Clarke Duncan in Daredevil (2003), a distinct variant from the Netflix Kingpin.

characters.name: Franklin Nelson
characters.summary: Matt Murdock's best friend and law partner. He is the warm, comic-relief conscience of the pair.
source_notes: Played by Jon Favreau in Daredevil (2003).

characters.name: Jack Murdock
characters.summary: Matt's father, a washed-up boxer who refused to throw a fight and was murdered on the Kingpin's orders, triggering Matt's quest for justice.
source_notes: Played by David Keith in Daredevil (2003).

characters.name: Stick
characters.summary: A blind martial-arts master and leader of the warrior order the Chaste. In the spinoff film he recruits Elektra to defeat the Hand's assassins.
source_notes: Played by Terence Stamp in Elektra (2005), a distinct variant from the Netflix Stick.

characters.name: Abby Miller
characters.summary: A schoolgirl whose death was prophesied by the Kimagure scroll. Her mother enlists Elektra to protect her from the Hand's assassin, Typhoid Mary.
source_notes: Played by Kirby Bliss Blanton in Elektra (2005).

characters.name: Typhoid Mary
characters.summary: A deadly Hand assassin who can create illusions and wield a lethal touch. She is sent to kill the girl Elektra protects and is ultimately defeated.
characters.image_alt: Typhoid Mary in typhoid ward of New York city
source_notes: Played by Natassia Malthe in Elektra (2005).

characters.name: Howard
characters.summary: A wisecracking, anthropomorphic duck from the planet Duckworld who is accidentally dragged to Earth by a laser experiment. He battles an interdimensional evil overlord and saves Earth, later appearing in the MCU's post-credits scenes.
source_notes: Played by Ed Gale (suit) with Chip Zien's voice in Howard the Duck (1986). An MCU variant voiced by Seth Green appears in Guardians of the Galaxy and Avengers: Endgame.

characters.name: Beverly Switzler
characters.summary: A struggling rock singer who befriends and becomes the romantic partner of the stranded Howard the Duck, helping him battle the dark overlord.
source_notes: Played by Lea Thompson in Howard the Duck (1986).

characters.name: The Overlord
characters.summary: A malevolent interdimensional entity that manifests by possessing a human body to open a doorway through which its power can enter Earth. It is destroyed by Howard and Beverly.
source_notes: Played by Jeffrey Jones in Howard the Duck (1986).

characters.name: The Man-Thing
characters.summary: A scientist transformed into a giant plant-monster guardian of a swamp, empowered by the Nexus of All Realities. He rises to defend the land from corporate corruption.
source_notes: Played by Conan Stevens in Man-Thing (2005), a direct-to-video film.

characters.name: Pete Kasady
characters.summary: A corrupt land developer determined to seize the swamp's oil at any cost. Intoxicated by the Nexus's power, he is dragged to his death by the Man-Thing.
source_notes: Played by Matthew Le Nevez in Man-Thing (2005).

characters.name: Nick Fury
characters.summary: The commander of S.H.I.E.L.D. in a television film continuity. He faces off against the terrorist organization HYDRA, led by Baron Strucker, who plots to release a deadly bio-weapon over Manhattan.
characters.image_alt: Screen capture from Nick Fury: Agent of S.H.I.E.L.D. (1998).Featuring David Hasselhoff as Nick Fury.
source_notes: Played by David Hasselhoff in the 1998 television film, a distinct variant from Samuel L. Jackson's MCU Nick Fury.

characters.name: Baron Wolfgang von Strucker
characters.summary: The ruthless leader of HYDRA who plots to destroy the eastern seaboard's telecommunications with a super-weapon. He is killed by Nick Fury.
source_notes: Played by Neil Roberts in the 1998 television film, a distinct variant from Thomas Kretschmann's MCU Baron Strucker.

characters.name: Steve Rogers
characters.summary: A weak young man transformed by the Super-Soldier Serum into Captain America. Frozen during World War II, he is revived in the 1990s to stop the Red Skull's catastrophic plot.
source_notes: Played by Matt Salinger in Captain America (1990), the final pre-MCU Captain America film.

characters.name: Johann Schmidt
characters.summary: Captain America's monstrous Nazi enemy with a red, disfigured face. He reveals he is Steve Rogers' lifelong friend aligned with fascism and is defeated in a final confrontation.
characters.image_alt: Martin Johann Schmidt (Kremser-Schmidt) (around 1790) by Paul Haubenstricker
source_notes: Played by Scott Paulin in Captain America (1990), a distinct variant from Hugo Weaving's MCU Red Skull.
